Design a navigation aid that keeps a rider's eyes on the road:
a small display paired with a phone, showing only what matters

© 2026 Faizan Haidri — Industrial Design, NID Haryana
A compact system tackling moisture damage in hearing aids — to
extend device life and simplify maintenance. Ongoing.
Moisture is a major cause of hearing aid damage: battery
issues, earwax-plus-moisture blocking components, static noise
and feedback, malfunction and reduced lifespan. Causes range
from sweat and humid weather to stepping out of an
air-conditioned room. The goal: a compact, user-friendly
dehumidification system that protects hearing aids effectively
without exposing them to harmful heat.
Ran a market study of existing dryers — from ₹200–500
desiccant jars to ₹8,000–12,000 electronic units — and a
failure analysis: most products leave relative humidity at
25–30%, far above the sub-10% hearing aids need, while
unregulated heat corrodes circuits. Tested molecular-sieve
(3A) desiccant against silica gel for aggressive low-humidity
adsorption. Architected RF dielectric heating at 13.56 MHz
with channeled airflow inside a Faraday cage, powered by a
3.7V Li-ion cell over USB-C. Ran sculptural form explorations,
including studies inspired by the bearded vulture, toward an
A resolved concept with a validated desiccant approach, RF
heating architecture, and form studies in progress —
identified as the strongest patent candidate in a portfolio

Modular outdoor seating in concrete and wood — ergonomic, for all
age groups, across multiple seating postures.
Construct an outdoor public furniture system that is
ergonomic, usable by all age groups, and supports multiple
seating postures — built to endure decades of public use.
Started with a miniature sun-board model reinforced with metal
mesh, then poured white cement with dyes to visualise the
final piece. Drew a 1:1 CAD print to map the mold for screwing
and pouring concrete. Built the full-scale rebar structure —
bending, welding, and assembling on site — before the final
pour. Guided by Dyutiman Moulik, over 8 weeks.
Full-scale concrete loungers installed outdoors and tested by
real users — comfort, openness, and durability across seasons.
